Hazvigoneke kubatana ne D-Bus session bus.
Batidza extension yeGNOME Shell inonzi “Keyboard Changer” (ona gnome-extension/ muprojekiti), wozobuda woapinda zvakare.
Iyi desktop session (%1) haitsigirwe. Zvinotsigirwa: X11 desktops, KDE Plasma, GNOME, Sway, Hyprland.
Mitemo yewebhusaiti yakadzimwa: port %1 pa127.0.0.1 iri kushandiswa.

Kuti uchinje maererano newebhusaiti, isa Keyboard Changer extension mubrowser yako (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Yandex, Firefox). Inotumira domain yetab inoshanda chete kuapplication iyi kuburikidza neport %1.
Browser extension yabatana. Shanduko yekupedzisira yetab: %1.
Hapana mitemo parizvino. Dzvanya + kuti uwedzere, kana wedzera preset.
Kutanga kana wapinda kwakadzimwa mu system settings. Bvumira Keyboard Changer ipapo.
Kutanga kana wapinda kwadzimwa nemutariri wako.
Inochinja kurongeka kwekiyibhodhi maererano newebhusaiti. Inotumira domain yetab inoshanda chete kuKeyboard Changer app pakombiyuta iyi.
Port yeKeyboard Changer app (yakafanana neiri muapp, default 47863).
Chimwe chinhu chiri kupindura paport iyi.
Keyboard Changer haisi kushanda kana kuti iri kushandisa imwe port.
